definition.def: When you deny something, you state that it is not true.
examples: The government has denied that there was a plot to assassinate the president. [VERB that]
They all denied ever having seen her. [VERB verb-ing]

definition.def: If you deny someone or something, you say that they have no connection with you or do not belong to you. [formal]
examples: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you deny someone something that they need or want, you refuse to let them have it.
examples: If he is unlucky, he may find that his ex-partner denies him access to his children. [VERB noun noun]
Don't deny yourself pleasure. [V pron-refl n]
My mother denied herself for us. [VERB pronoun-reflexive]

examples.sentence: "Different governments have different attitudes," he says, and goes on to explain that some countries place a high priority on restoring wetlands, while others still deny the issue.
Perhaps as a consequence, schools would often deny the problem.
No one can deny that this coffee house is located in a beautiful setting.
